blocks.html: Robinsons Place Malolos is hailed as the Shopping Center of the Year in the recently held 19th Outstanding Filipino Retailers and Shopping Center of the Year Awards at Manila Marriot Hotel. Robinsons Place Malolos emerged as the over-all winner under Small Category as it outstood its major competitors in the industry with its excellence in the following fields- Marketing and Promotions, Operations, Sales, Environment, and Reputation. To date, Robinsons Malls have garnered 8 Shopping Center of the Year Awards starting with Robinsons Place Tacloban in 2010; Robinsons Ilocos in 2011; Robinsons Place Dumaguete in 2012; Robinsons Magnolia in 2013; Robinsons Place Palawan in 2014; and Robinsons Magnolia in 2014. Robinsons Magnolia is also a Hall of Fame Awardee for winning Shopping Center of the Year for 2 consecutive years. Robinsons Place Malolos is the 35th Robinsons Mall built by Robinsons Land Corporation (RLC) and is one of the 7 Robinsons shopping malls located in North Luzon. Situated along Mac Arthur Highway in Brgy. Sumapang Matanda, Malolos City, the mall is a 67,000 square meter commercial establishment and the first full-service mall in Malolos City, Bulacan. It was inaugurated in December 2013 and since then has become the local community’s favorite destination for shopping, dining and entertainment. The mall is highly patronized by more than 3 million Bulakeños and tourists. The 4 levels of Robinsons Place Malolos offer an exciting and complete array of fashion and apparel; I.T. gadgets; sportswear and equipment; children’s apparel and toys; jewelry and accessories; home furnishings and decor; and health and beauty boutiques. Pastry shops and cafés; popular fast food chains; and family amusement and entertainment centers abound in this sprawling shopping mall. Robinsons Department Store, Robinsons Supermarket, Robinsons Appliances, Robinsons Movieworld, Handyman, South Star Drug, and Robinsons Bank are also located inside the mall. Avid movie-goers flock to the mall to experience the 4 state-of the-art digital cinemas including a 3D cinema. Meanwhile, the mall has also been Bulakeños’ “top of mind” when securing government-related documents and requirements with Robinsons Malls Lingkod Pinoy Center located at the 4th floor. Robinsons Malls Lingkod Pinoy Center in Robinsons Place Malolos is the first in the province to house government agencies such as DTI, PAG-IBIG, TESDA, SB Corp., SSS and PhilHealth under one roof. Present during the awarding ceremony were (L-R) PRA Vice Chairman Ms. Alegria Limjoco; DTI Secretary Mr. Adrian Cristobal Jr.; Mr. Edmund Caparas, RLC Commercial Centers Division Regional Operations Manager; Ms. Lourdes Alano, RLC Commercial Centers Division VP for Lease; Mr. Irving Wu, RLC Commercial Centers Division Operations Director – Luzon; and Mr. Samie Lim, PRA Chairman Emiritus.
